label: Historical name rule
rule: Case-insensitive TADALAFIL substring in DRUGNAME; any role
boundary: Historical reconciliation; substring matching can include analogues and miss brand-only reports

label: Ingredient expansion
rule: Historical rule OR uppercase/whitespace-normalized PROD_AI exactly TADALAFIL; any role
boundary: Specified union expansion, not a complete validated drug ontology

label: Exact-brand extension
rule: Ingredient expansion OR normalized DRUGNAME exactly CIALIS or ADCIRCA; any role
boundary: Only these two corroborated brands added; no fuzzy matching or unverified aliases

label: Combination ingredient tokens
rule: Ingredient expansion OR exact TADALAFIL token in PROD_AI split on backslash, slash, semicolon, comma, plus or ampersand; any role
boundary: Adds 18 eligible OPSYNVI reports, all non-CSCR; a unchanged, b +18 and d -18

label: Brands plus combination tokens
rule: Exact-brand extension OR the same exact ingredient-token rule; any role
boundary: Combination/brand extension uses the full reporting background

label: Ingredient tokens with analogue exclusion
rule: Combination-token rule after excluding the exact CHLOROPRETADALAFIL row unless an accepted tadalafil ingredient token is present; any role
boundary: The one selected analogue report also contains a genuine TADALAFIL PS row; no report exposure changes

label: Brands and tokens with analogue exclusion
rule: Brand-plus-token rule with the same row-level analogue exclusion; any role
boundary: No report exposure changes versus brand-plus-token definition

label: Ingredient expansion, primary suspect
rule: Ingredient expansion restricted to qualifying rows coded PS
boundary: Role-restricted comparison, not evidence of causality or administration

label: Ingredient expansion, suspect roles
rule: Ingredient expansion restricted to qualifying rows coded PS or SS
boundary: Different reporting question; use its own full four-cell background
